description: A route typed or pasted, read as the route box and Type Route take it: each word as item 15 of a flight plan has it (AIM Appendix 4, route_read: DCT out, a speed and level group the cruise asked for), a position's "@42.1,-88.2" kept whole, the SIDs and STARs among the words (route_procedures; AIM 5-2-9, 5-4-1) the route's procedures, not points, and the rest the points whose form is a stop's (point_kind). goes_on where the words end in a procedure, its field still to be typed. Which field publishes a procedure, and as which kind, is the caller's, from the field's procedures.

words.description: The words typed, each trimmed and uppercased here; blanks left out.

procedures.description: false where the caller has nowhere to send procedures: every word is then read as a point.

words.description: The words read, DCT and the level group taken out.

points.description: The points among them in order, each a stop's form, the procedures left out.

procedures.description: The SIDs and STARs among the words, each with the nearest point before and after it (route_procedures).

cruise_ft.description: The cruise the first level group asked for, feet.
